rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the main point or focus receiving special attention.

example.english: The emphasis of this report is environmental protection.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅重點係環保。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zung6 dim2 hai6 waan4 bou2

rows.note: Use this for emphasis conveyed through the force or tone of someone’s spoken delivery.

example.english: The emphasis in the way you say this sounds like you are scolding someone.
example.traditional: 你講呢句嘅語氣好重，聽落好似鬧緊人。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 ni1 geoi3 ge3 jyu5 hei3 hou2 zung6 ting1 lok6 hou2 ci5 naau6 gan2 jan4

rows.note: Use this specifically for prominence placed on a syllable or word in speech.

example.english: The teacher told me to put emphasis on the second syllable.
example.traditional: 老師叫我喺第二個音節加重音。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 hai2 dai6 ji6 go3 jam1 zit3 gaa1 cung5 jam1
